root_cause: Existing continuous-improvement and Engineering-OS loops did not expose one explicit universal daily contract that treats chats, agents and skills as first-class optimizable capabilities.
prevention: Every material chat/agent/skill capability participates in daily evidence collection and the canonical improvement lifecycle. Blind self-modification is forbidden; promotion requires representative evals, non-regression, rollback identity and production readback.
authority: existing Powerhouse Brain/Supabase and protected GitHub delivery only
